brief: Slovenian personnel and org-change reporting on banks is spread across general business desks rather than concentrated in named appointments columns: the highest-value breakers are Finance (paywalled and bot-defended in this run), the STA wire (subscription), and Delo's Gospodarstvo/Kariera, while Siol's 'Posel danes', Forbes Slovenija on the N1 platform, N1 Slovenija and RTV SLO provide the strongest free, open-access streams with stable URL patterns and confirmed bank-CEO coverage. English routes exist but are strictly a subset — SeeNews and FinTech Futures pick up foreign-owned subsidiaries such as Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenia, so Slovenian-language monitoring is non-optional. Non-media pointers materially improve precision: Združenje bank Slovenije announcements and Bančni vestnik bylines reveal current senior office-holders with far less noise than press keywords, since 'kadrovske spremembe'/'imenovanja' in Slovenian media is dominated by government reshuffles and must always be ANDed with a bank or actor term. Main weaknesses of this cell are paid-archive access to the four leading dailies and near-absent coverage of non-bank payments actors.
